source_text:
17.40
Συνεπόδισας πάντας τοὺς ἐπανισ ταμένους ἐπ' ἐμὲ ὑποκάτω μου.
Καὶ μὴν οὐκ
ι σμεν τὸν ∆αυὶδ τῶν ἐχθρῶν βασιλεύσαντα· οὐκοῦν διὰ τοῦ ἐξ αὐτοῦ κατὰ σάρκα
τεχθέντος ἡ προφητεία πληροῦται.
pass_a_gloss: You-shackled all the ones-rising-up upon me underneath me. And indeed not we-know the David of-the enemies having-reigned; therefore through the out-of him according-to flesh having-been-born the prophecy is-fulfilled.
pass_b_english: “You shackled all who rise up against me under me” (Psalm 17:40).
And yet we do not know David as having reigned over the enemies; therefore through the one born from him according to the flesh the prophecy is fulfilled.

choices.term: Συνεπόδισας πάντας τοὺς ἐπανισταμένους ἐπ' ἐμὲ ὑποκάτω μου
choices.english: You shackled all who rise up against me under me
choices.why: συμποδίζω is to bind the feet. Not ‘you followed those who rose’.
rejected: you followed all who rise against me

choices.term: οὐκ ἴσμεν τὸν Δαυὶδ τῶν ἐχθρῶν βασιλεύσαντα
choices.english: we do not know David as having reigned over the enemies
choices.why: OCR ι σμεν. Historical David did not so reign; the lemma waits for Christ.
rejected: we know David reigned over the enemies
we do not know David’s enemies

choices.term: διὰ τοῦ ἐξ αὐτοῦ κατὰ σάρκα τεχθέντος
choices.english: through the one born from him according to the flesh
choices.why: The one born of David according to the flesh. Not ‘through his own flesh’.
rejected: through his own flesh being born
through David born according to flesh

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
